title: Ask GeneBridge
subtitle: General questions about genetics and inheritance, in plain language.
boundary: I can explain genetics and inheritance. I can't diagnose or tell you what to decide. For anything about your own situation, I'll connect you with a counsellor.
offlineNote: Running in offline mode: answers come straight from the GeneBridge library.

suggestions.label: Try asking
items: What does being a carrier mean?
How does cousin marriage affect inherited risk?

input.label: Your question
input.tooLong: Please keep your question under {max} characters.

toggle.label: Use my result in this chat
toggle.hint: When on, the assistant can see your result summary (condition and carrier status), never your raw data.

family.share: Share my family map with this chat
family.shared: Family map shared for this chat
family.hint: Only relations and statuses are shared, never names. For this conversation only.

report.title: Explain my screening report
report.paste: Paste the text of your report
report.upload: Or upload a PDF or photo
report.uploadNote: Uploaded files are sent to our AI provider to read the text, then deleted. Only the text is kept, in this conversation, for 30 days.
report.uploadOff: Uploading needs the full AI assistant, which isn't switched on. Paste the text instead.
report.question: Please explain my report line by line.
report.tooBig: That file is too large (5 MB maximum).

escalation.title: Talk to a genetic counsellor

escalation.share: Share a short summary of this conversation with the counsellor
escalation.summaryLabel: Summary to share (you can edit it)
escalation.sent: Request sent. Choose a time on the next page.
escalation.failed: Couldn't send the request. Please try again.
escalation.openChat: You can keep asking general questions here.
